title: Line Height (Leading) Calibration
ques: Explain the difference between `leading-none`, `leading-snug`, and `leading-relaxed`. Write an article paragraph demonstrating readability optimization with `leading-relaxed`.

answer.content:
Designing for Accessible Human Experiences

Typographic research consistently proves that adequate line spacing significantly reduces cognitive fatigue during reading. By giving each line sufficient breathing room, readers navigate paragraphs effortlessly without losing their place.

explanation: `leading-*` classes manage `line-height`. Titles benefit from `leading-tight` (1.25) to avoid huge gaps, while body prose benefits from `leading-relaxed` (1.625) for high legibility.
